info.title: Majikah Public API
info.description: Public REST API for Majikah services including MUID identity, trusted timestamps (TSA), SLinks, and blockchain document notarization. This specification is intended to stay synchronized with the production gateway.

tags.name: MUID
tags.description: Majikah Universal Identity public and authenticated profile operations.

tags.name: TSA
tags.description: Trusted timestamp issuance and credit/quota operations.

tags.name: SLink
tags.description: Signed URL/content claim creation, lookup, verification, and deletion.

tags.name: Notary
tags.description: Document seal-hash payment, blockchain anchoring, and confirmation status.

get.description: Returns the gateway health status and current Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

head.summary: Check API health without a response body
head.description: Liveness check. A healthy gateway responds with HTTP 200 and no response body.

200.description: Gateway is healthy. Response body is empty.

get.description: Returns the MUID associated with the authenticated API identity.
Looks up a public MUID profile by MUID ID or username.

post.summary: Verify signature envelope against a MUID
post.description: Verifies a Majik Signature JSON envelope and optionally checks that it belongs to a specific MUID.

data.reason: Signature is valid and signer matches the requested MUID.

400.description: Invalid signature envelope or request body.

post.description: Creates a signed trusted timestamp for a supplied digest. If the same digest is already cached within the configured rolling cache window, the existing timestamp token may be returned without consuming another credit.

200.description: Timestamp token issued or returned from cache.

example.message: TSA quota ledger service temporarily unavailable

get.description: Returns the authenticated caller's free and paid TSA credit balances and the next free-credit reset time.

post.description: Creates a signed SLink claim from the supplied URL/content metadata and signature envelope.

422.description: Challenge code not found during DNS/HTML verification.

example.message: Challenge code not found during DNS/HTML verification

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of SLinks to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous request.

get.summary: Search SLink claims by URL or content hash
get.description: Provide either `url` or `hash` to search for matching SLink claims.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to normalize, hash, and search against.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Direct content hash to search against.

400.description: Missing query parameters or invalid URL.

get.summary: Get public view of a single SLink claim

delete.description: Deletes the SLink claim associated with the authenticated owner.

post.summary: Create or resume payment order for document anchoring
post.description: Creates a payment intent for a document seal hash. If the document is already anchored, the existing anchor is returned and no payment is required.

200.description: Payment intent created, resumed, or an existing anchor returned.

value.message: Payment intent created — anchor will process once payment confirms
This document is already anchored — no payment needed

409.description: Payment already completed for this document.

example.message: Payment already completed for this document

post.summary: Submit seal hash for on-chain anchoring
post.description: Submits a previously paid seal hash for blockchain anchoring. The same seal hash used for payment must be supplied.

200.description: Anchor submitted or an existing anchor returned.

402.description: No completed payment found for this seal hash.

example.error: No completed payment found for this seal hash — call POST /notary/v1/payment first with the same sealHash

503.description: Service temporarily unavailable due to fee-payer balance.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Majikah API key supplied in the `x-api-key` HTTP header.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard API error envelope. Some legacy endpoints may return `error` instead of `message`.

error.example: No completed payment found for this seal hash — call POST /notary/v1/payment first with the same sealHash

MajikSignatureEnvelope.description: Simplified representation of a Majik Signature JSON envelope.

id.description: Optional MUID ID to verify against.

reason.example: Signature is valid and signer matches the requested MUID.

sealHash.description: SHA3-512 document seal hash used as the immutable anchoring identifier.

blockTime.description: Solana block time as Unix seconds when available.

message.example: Payment intent created — anchor will process once payment confirms
